question: Should plain `birdclaw init` implicitly resolve xurl's default authenticated account, or should authenticated identity replacement require explicit `--account` or hydration intent?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically possible, but choosing between convenient automatic correction and compatibility with deterministic local initialization establishes a permanent CLI and authentication boundary.

options.title: Require explicit selection
options.body: Gate authenticated lookup behind `--account` or the existing explicit hydration workflow so ordinary initialization remains local and deterministic.

options.title: Make init authentication-aware
options.body: Allow plain initialization to adopt xurl's default account, with documented offline and multi-account semantics plus fresh-install and upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Require explicit selection
recommendation.body: Gate authenticated lookup behind `--account` or the existing explicit hydration workflow so ordinary initialization remains local and deterministic.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice changes the default CLI and authentication contract and therefore needs repository-level product direction.
